short_bio: British theoretical physicist and author of A Brief History of Time.
biography:
Stephen Hawking was born in Oxford in 1942 and studied at University College, Oxford, and then at Cambridge. In 1963, aged 21, he was diagnosed with motor neurone disease, and he lost the use of his voice, later speaking through a synthesiser.

With Roger Penrose he proved singularity theorems about the origins of the universe, and in 1974 he showed that black holes emit radiation, now called Hawking radiation. He was Lucasian Professor of Mathematics at Cambridge from 1979 to 2009.

A Brief History of Time (1988) sold in the millions. He received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2009 and died on 14 March 2018.

awards.title: Commander of the Order of the British Empire
